title: Version
description: One archive version as published by GET /api/versions and GET /api/versions/{id}.

id.description: Stable identifier, derived from the archive file name without its extension. Used in every /api/versions/{id}/... path.

fileName.description: Name of the archive file inside the server's --archives directory.

size.description: Size of the archive in bytes.

sizeHuman.description: Human readable rendering of size. Informational only; never parse this, use size.

hashAlgorithm.description: Algorithm behind every hash field in this document.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the complete archive file, lower case hex. This is the value the client verifies its rebuilt file against.

blueprintSha256.description: SHA-256 of the gzipped blueprint served by GET /api/versions/{id}/blueprint. Lets a client cache the blueprint and detect a changed one.

blueprintBytes.description: Size of the gzipped blueprint in bytes. Part of what a delta transfer costs.

blockRefs.description: Number of block references in the blueprint, counting repeats.

distinctBlocks.description: Number of distinct blocks the version needs. Never larger than blockRefs; the difference is deduplication inside this one version.

containers.description: Nested archive containers that were decomposed, including the outer archive itself.

opaqueContainers.description: Containers that looked like an archive but could not be reproduced byte for byte and are therefore transferred as plain blocks. Correctness is unaffected; a value above 0 only means the delta for this version is larger than it could be.

ingestedAt.description: UTC instant at which the server decomposed this archive (ISO-8601).
